sentences.zh: 太空探索七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最强的球队。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 现在订阅可享特别优惠，请访问 nytimes.com/subscribe。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Rachel Abrams, and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的瑞秋·艾布拉姆斯，这是《每日简报》节目。

sentences.en: The presidential campaign is in its final week, and one thing still remains true.
sentences.zh: 总统竞选进入最后一周，有一件事依然是不争的事实。

sentences.en: The election is probably going to come down to just a handful of voters in a few swing states.
sentences.zh: 选举结果很可能取决于几个摇摆州里少数选民的投票。

sentences.en: Today, my colleagues Jessica Chung and Jonathan Swan take us inside Donald Trump's unorthodox campaign to win over those voters.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事杰西卡·钟和乔纳森·斯旺将带我们深入了解唐纳德·特朗普争取这些选民的非传统竞选方式。

sentences.en: It's Monday, October 28th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月28日，星期一。

sentences.en: Prevailing wisdom in American politics dictates that the ground game matters.
sentences.zh: 美国政治中的主流观点认为，地面战至关重要。

sentences.en: Things like door knocking, phone banking, and getting out the vote.
sentences.zh: 比如挨家挨户敲门、电话拉票以及动员投票等工作。

sentences.en: But in a race that looks as tight as the 2024 presidential election, the ground game can be the difference between winning and losing.
sentences.zh: 但在像2024年总统大选这样胶着的选战中，地面战可能就是决定胜负的关键。

sentences.en: The Harris campaign has been running a really traditional and extremely well-funded ground operation.
sentences.zh: 哈里斯竞选团队一直在开展一场非常传统且资金极其雄厚的地面行动。

sentences.en: It has paid staff members and armies of canvassers who are all focused on turning out every single voter they can find.
sentences.zh: 他们有带薪员工和庞大的拉票员队伍，所有人都在专注于动员他们能找到的每一位选民。

sentences.en: The Trump campaign, on the other hand, they've got a totally different approach.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，特朗普竞选团队则采取了完全不同的策略。

sentences.en: First of all, they've got less money and less paid staff, so it's a smaller ground operation.
sentences.zh: 首先，他们的资金和带薪员工较少，所以地面行动规模较小。

sentences.en: Some of the get-out-the-vote work has been taken on by outside groups, like Elon Musk's Super PAC.
sentences.zh: 部分动员投票的工作由外部团体承担，比如埃隆·马斯克的超级政治行动委员会。

sentences.en: And the actual field offices, they're leaning a lot more heavily on volunteers.
sentences.zh: 而实际的竞选办公室则更多地依赖志愿者。

sentences.en: To get a sense of what this effort looks like inside one of those offices, we sent Daily producer Jessica Chung to a key place in a key swing state, Maricopa County, Arizona.
sentences.zh: 为了了解这些工作在办公室内部是如何开展的，我们派出了《每日简报》的制片人杰西卡·钟前往关键摇摆州的一个关键地点——亚利桑那州马里科帕县。

sentences.en: It's the most populous county in the state where more than half of all of Arizona's voters live.
sentences.zh: 这是该州人口最多的县，亚利桑那州超过一半的选民居住于此。

sentences.en: Trump won it in 2016, and then Biden eked out a victory there in 2020.
sentences.zh: 特朗普在2016年赢下了该县，随后拜登在2020年以微弱优势胜出。

sentences.en: Here's Jess.
sentences.zh: 下面是杰西卡的报道。

sentences.en: You want to speak from Maricopa County?
sentences.zh: 你想在马里科帕县采访吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: The office of the Maricopa County Republican Party is just southeast of Phoenix.
sentences.zh: 马里科帕县共和党办公室位于菲尼克斯的东南部。

sentences.en: It sits on a quiet street in an anonymous-looking office park next to a tiling company.
sentences.zh: 它坐落在一个安静的街道上，位于一个看起来很普通的办公园区内，隔壁是一家瓷砖公司。

sentences.en: He'll be right now.
sentences.zh: 他马上就来。

sentences.en: Okay, thanks.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢。

sentences.en: I got there on a Tuesday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我是周二下午到达那里的。

sentences.en: Hi, you must be Craig.
sentences.zh: 嗨，你一定是克雷格吧。

sentences.en: Yes, how are you?
sentences.zh: 是的，你好吗？

sentences.en: Hi, nice to meet you.
sentences.zh: 嗨，很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: I'm Jess.
sentences.zh: 我是杰西卡。

sentences.en: Craig Berlind is the chair of the Maricopa County Republican Committee.
sentences.zh: 克雷格·伯林德是马里科帕县共和党委员会的主席。

sentences.en: He has all the businessman staples.
sentences.zh: 他具备了商人的所有典型特征。

sentences.en: Warm smile, tidy suit, wire-rimmed glasses, handshake firm, but not too firm.
sentences.zh: 温暖的微笑、整洁的西装、金属框眼镜，握手有力但不过分。

sentences.en: Go upstairs?
sentences.zh: 上楼吗？

sentences.en: Yes!
sentences.zh: 好的！

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 没问题。

sentences.en: Or maybe like a little tour, too.
sentences.zh: 或者也许可以参观一下。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: We go upstairs, and Craig starts to show me around.
sentences.zh: 我们上楼，克雷格开始带我参观。

sentences.en: Oh, so this is new.
sentences.zh: 哦，这是新的吗？

sentences.en: This is pretty new.
sentences.zh: 这是相当新的。

sentences.en: Oh, where were you guys before?
sentences.zh: 哦，你们之前在哪里？

sentences.en: We didn't have a place.
sentences.zh: 我们之前没有固定的地方。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇。

sentences.en: We basically bummed around.
sentences.zh: 我们基本上是到处流浪。

sentences.en: The Maricopa Republicans just moved here in May, but they've really made this place their own.
sentences.zh: 马里科帕共和党人今年五月才搬到这里，但他们确实把这里变成了自己的地盘。

sentences.en: First of all, I don't know if you noticed when you walked in, but all the windows outside are mirrored,
sentences.zh: 首先，不知道你进来时有没有注意到，外面的所有窗户都是镜面的，

sentences.en: and the American and Arizona flag are mirrored in all the windows as you're walking in.
sentences.zh: 当你走进来时，美国国旗和亚利桑那州旗在所有的窗户上都有倒影。

sentences.en: Once you get inside, this place might look like any random office space, were it not for the decor, which is festively Trump.
sentences.zh: 一旦进入内部，如果不是因为那些充满节日气氛的特朗普主题装饰，这里看起来可能和任何普通的办公空间没什么两样。

sentences.en: A lot of it's Trump-related.
sentences.zh: 很多东西都与特朗普有关。

sentences.en: At the top of the steps, there's a life-size cardboard cutout of the former president with Melania.
sentences.zh: 楼梯顶部有一个真人大小的特朗普与梅拉尼娅的纸板立牌。

sentences.en: In the lobby, there's a large-screen TV with Trump giving a speech.
sentences.zh: 大厅里有一台大屏幕电视，播放着特朗普的演讲。

sentences.en: There's red balloons all over.
sentences.zh: 到处都是红色的气球。

sentences.en: And there are portraits.
sentences.zh: 还有肖像画。

sentences.en: Lincoln, Reagan, Frederick Douglass, and Trump.
sentences.zh: 林肯、里根、弗雷德里克·道格拉斯和特朗普。

sentences.en: You got a whole store.
sentences.zh: 你简直拥有了一整家店。

sentences.en: And there's merch.
sentences.zh: 这里还有周边商品。

sentences.en: Tons of merch.
sentences.zh: 大量的周边。

sentences.en: There's all kinds of T-shirts and hats.
sentences.zh: 各种各样的T恤和帽子。

sentences.en: Craig points to a glass conference room that's been repurposed to what he refers to as a Trump store.
sentences.zh: 克雷格指着一个玻璃会议室，那里被改造成了他所说的“特朗普商店”。

sentences.en: However, it's stuffed with racks of shirts.
sentences.zh: 然而，里面塞满了成排的衬衫。

sentences.en: And there are flags that say God, guns, and guts.
sentences.zh: 还有写着“上帝、枪支和胆识”的旗帜。

sentences.en: But there's also some men's rings, and I think there's an $800 pair of golden tennis shoes in there.
sentences.zh: 但里面也有一些男士戒指，我想还有一双价值800美元的金色网球鞋。

sentences.en: And I imagine the proceeds would go to the county office.
sentences.zh: 我想收益应该会归县办公室所有。

sentences.en: It helps us.
sentences.zh: 这能帮助我们。

sentences.en: Yeah, right.
sentences.zh: 是啊，没错。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: These days, Craig says he's here 50 hours a week, fundraising, planning events, and helping to direct,
sentences.zh: 克雷格说，这些天他每周在这里工作50个小时，负责筹款、策划活动，并协助指挥，

sentences.en: according to him, more than 1,000 volunteers who come here to elect Republicans.
sentences.zh: 据他所说，有超过1000名志愿者来到这里，致力于选举共和党人。

sentences.en: In this close election, Arizona is a big deal.
sentences.zh: 在这次势均力敌的选举中，亚利桑那州至关重要。

sentences.en: Polls show it could be very close again.
sentences.zh: 民调显示，这里可能再次出现非常胶着的局面。

sentences.en: And just to remind you, when Biden won the state in 2020, he won by less than 11,000 votes.
sentences.zh: 提醒一下，2020年拜登赢得该州时，优势不到11,000票。

sentences.en: That was out of more than 3 million votes caSt.
sentences.zh: 那是在超过300万张选票中产生的。

sentences.en: In a place like this, efforts to get voters to the polls could be the difference between winning and losing.
sentences.zh: 在这样的地方，动员选民投票的努力可能就是决定胜负的关键。

sentences.en: And to understand what this office is doing, and its mission in these critical final days, it's helpful to know the story of how Craig ended up here.
sentences.zh: 为了理解这个办公室在做什么，以及它在这些关键的最后几天里的使命，了解克雷格是如何来到这里的很有帮助。

sentences.en: I grew up in Kansas, in a very small farming and oil country.
sentences.zh: 我在堪萨斯州长大，那里是一个非常小的农业和石油地区。

sentences.en: Craig was a small-town kid turned businessman.
sentences.zh: 克雷格是一个从小镇走出来的商人。

sentences.en: He worked for General Motors.
sentences.zh: 他曾在通用汽车工作。

sentences.en: And eventually, he moved his family to Arizona, where he started an aerospace company.
sentences.zh: 最终，他带着家人搬到了亚利桑那州，在那里创办了一家航空航天公司。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was like many Americans, right?
sentences.zh: 是的，就像许多美国人一样，对吧？

sentences.en: Your head's down.
sentences.zh: 你埋头苦干。

sentences.en: You know, you got payroll to make.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你要发工资。

sentences.en: You got new quotes to make.
sentences.zh: 你要做新的报价。

sentences.en: You got product to ship.
sentences.zh: 你要发货。

sentences.en: Craig says he would vote Republican, but that was pretty much the extent of his political involvement.
sentences.zh: 克雷格说他会投票给共和党，但这就是他政治参与的全部了。

sentences.en: Until 2020.
Well, I didn't like what happened in the 2020 election.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不喜欢2020年大选中发生的事情。

sentences.en: I remember sitting there in our family room, switching from one station to the next, and then getting my phone out and looking for the New York Times or somebody
sentences.zh: 我记得当时坐在家里的起居室里，从一个频道换到另一个频道，然后拿出手机查看《纽约时报》或其他媒体，

sentences.en: to see what the counts of ballots were and what was left and mentally doing math.
sentences.zh: 看看计票结果是多少，还剩下多少，然后在脑子里做数学题。

sentences.en: If you forgot, during the 2020 election,
sentences.zh: 如果你忘了的话，在2020年大选期间，

sentences.en: Maricopa County was ground zero for an ugly fight over alleged election fraud.
sentences.zh: 马里科帕县是关于所谓选举舞弊丑陋争斗的中心地带。

sentences.en: It started on election night.
sentences.zh: 这一切始于选举之夜。

sentences.en: I can say that when we became very concerned is when all of a sudden, counting started shutting down at many states, right?
sentences.zh: 我可以肯定地说，我们感到非常担忧的时候，是突然之间，许多州的计票工作开始停止了，对吧？

sentences.en: You know, it was Atlanta, and it was Detroit, and it was, you know, and you're going, that's never happened before.
sentences.zh: 你知道，亚特兰大是这样，底特律也是这样，你会想，这以前从未发生过。

sentences.en: What's going on?
sentences.zh: 到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: Craig is referring to an allegation from 2020 that some battleground states where Donald Trump was ahead decided to stop counting in order to prevent him from winning.
sentences.zh: 克雷格指的是2020年的一项指控，称唐纳德·特朗普领先的一些摇摆州决定停止计票，以阻止他获胜。

sentences.en: This idea took off on Facebook among his supporters, who were suspicious of the voting system.
sentences.zh: 这个观点在他的支持者中通过Facebook传播开来，他们对投票系统持怀疑态度。

sentences.en: For the record, this theory has been thoroughly debunked.
sentences.zh: 郑重声明，这一理论已被彻底驳斥。

sentences.en: In Atlanta, counting was only paused briefly after a pipe burst on election day.
sentences.zh: 在亚特兰大，计票工作仅在选举日当天因水管爆裂而短暂暂停。

sentences.en: And election officials in other states said they never stopped counting votes, including, as Craig alleged, in Detroit.
sentences.zh: 其他州的选举官员表示，他们从未停止计票，包括克雷格所指的底特律。

sentences.en: But for Craig, he wasn't buying it.
sentences.zh: 但克雷格并不买账。

sentences.en: You know, we were all sitting there at night, and we seen that the candidates that we thought should win were winning.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们那天晚上都坐在那里，看到我们认为应该获胜的候选人正在获胜。

sentences.en: And then in the middle of the night, the voting stopped.
sentences.zh: 然后在半夜，投票停止了。

sentences.en: And when it restarted again, there was this shift.
sentences.zh: 当它再次开始时，出现了一种转变。

sentences.en: And I guess because of my engineering mind and the way I've been trained,
sentences.zh: 我想因为我的工程思维和受过的训练，

sentences.en: is that curve is not something that you see in nature.
sentences.zh: 那条曲线不是你在自然界中能看到的。

sentences.en: That's not a natural curve.
sentences.zh: 那不是一条自然的曲线。

sentences.en: Early results that night misleadingly suggested that Trump was bound for victory.
sentences.zh: 当晚的早期结果误导性地暗示特朗普即将获胜。

sentences.en: That could have been because Republican votes tend to dominate in rural areas, small towns where counting goes faster.
sentences.zh: 这可能是因为共和党的选票往往在农村地区和小城镇占主导地位，那里的计票速度更快。

sentences.en: And during the pandemic in 2020,
sentences.zh: 而在2020年疫情期间，

sentences.en: Democrats tended to cast far more mail-in ballots, which get counted later.
sentences.zh: 民主党人倾向于投出更多的邮寄选票，这些选票会被较晚统计。

sentences.en: Was it because at a certain point they started to count the mail-in ballots, which leaned more Democrat in certain counties?
sentences.zh: 是因为在某个时间点他们开始统计邮寄选票，而这些选票在某些县更倾向于民主党吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Here in Arizona, we've had mail-in ballots for a long time.
sentences.zh: 在亚利桑那州，我们长期以来一直有邮寄选票。

sentences.en: I didn't perceive as that should have been the reason.
sentences.zh: 我不认为那应该是原因。

sentences.en: Neither Craig nor his wife trusted the explanations they were hearing.
sentences.zh: 克雷格和他的妻子都不相信他们听到的解释。

sentences.en: You know, we both thought that something was awfully wrong, and we thought we needed to be more involved.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们都认为事情非常不对劲，我们认为我们需要更多地参与进来。

sentences.en: For Craig, more involved meant first joining We the People AZ Alliance, a far-right activist group.
sentences.zh: 对克雷格来说，更多地参与意味着首先加入“我们人民亚利桑那联盟”，一个极右翼激进组织。

sentences.en: Then he joined the county party.
sentences.zh: 然后他加入了县党部。

sentences.en: And eventually, he was elected chair of that party.
sentences.zh: 最终，他被选为该党的主席。

sentences.en: And to this day, do you still believe that Maricopa County actually went for Trump in 2020?
sentences.zh: 直到今天，你是否仍然相信马里科帕县在2020年实际上是支持特朗普的？

sentences.en: Despite, you know, many processes of verification, including a Florida firm had done a hand recount
sentences.zh: 尽管，你知道，经过了许多核实程序，包括一家佛罗里达公司进行了人工重新计票，

sentences.en: and found that there was actually like 300 more votes for Biden than the previous count.
sentences.zh: 发现拜登的选票实际上比之前的统计结果多了大约300张。

sentences.en: So I wonder where your beliefs are now.
sentences.zh: 所以我很想知道你现在的想法是什么。

sentences.en: It's a complicated question, and my intuition tells me that Trump won Arizona.
sentences.zh: 这是一个复杂的问题，我的直觉告诉我特朗普赢得了亚利桑那州。

sentences.en: And do I have proof of that?
sentences.zh: 我有证据吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: But what I do have is I do have proof that there was many, many, many, many ballots in Maricopa County that were counted that shouldn't have been legally.
sentences.zh: 但我确实有证据表明，马里科帕县有许多、许多、许多、许多选票在统计时是不合法的。

sentences.en: So how do I have that proof?
sentences.zh: 那么我怎么会有那个证据呢？

sentences.en: So here we go back.
sentences.zh: 我们回到过去。

sentences.en: The year before Craig became party chair, he helped lead a review of signatures on mail-in ballots in Maricopa County
sentences.zh: 在克雷格成为党主席的前一年，他协助领导了一项对马里科帕县邮寄选票签名的审查，

sentences.en: and is convinced that 10% of the mail-in ballots counted in 2020 should not have been.
sentences.zh: 并确信2020年统计的邮寄选票中有10%是不应该被计入的。

sentences.en: And that's because he claims the signatures on those ballots did not adequately match those on file.
sentences.zh: 这是因为他声称这些选票上的签名与存档签名不符。

sentences.en: A claim, experts say, is based on incomplete signature history and a flawed methodology.
sentences.zh: 专家表示，这一说法基于不完整的签名历史和有缺陷的方法论。

sentences.en: But it's still something he's very fixated on.
sentences.zh: 但这仍然是他非常执着的事情。

sentences.en: I'm telling you Craig's whole story because as soon as you start talking to others in the Maricopa County office, you start to realize how many people there are just like Craig.
sentences.zh: 我告诉你克雷格的整个故事，是因为一旦你开始与马里科帕县办公室里的其他人交谈，你就会意识到那里有多少人就像克雷格一样。

sentences.en: I started volunteering after the 2020 election.
sentences.zh: 我在2020年大选后开始做志愿者。

sentences.en: I wanted to find out why my vote didn't count.
sentences.zh: 我想弄清楚为什么我的选票没被计入。

sentences.en: I spent about two hours talking to volunteers who were phone banking.
sentences.zh: 我花了大约两个小时和那些负责电话拉票的志愿者交谈。

sentences.en: I was completely apolitical.
sentences.zh: 我以前完全不关心政治。

sentences.en: I was new.
sentences.zh: 我是个新人。

sentences.en: I had never, never volunteered in politics before.
sentences.zh: 我以前从来、从来没有参与过政治志愿活动。

sentences.en: Never.
sentences.zh: 从来没有。

sentences.en: And then it was after the 2020 election was stolen.
sentences.zh: 后来，在2020年大选被窃取之后。

sentences.en: Then it was like, OK, you've got to be more engaged.
sentences.zh: 当时我就觉得，好吧，你必须更积极地参与进来。

sentences.en: And it was at that point that I decided that I wanted my grandkids' votes to count.
sentences.zh: 也就是在那时，我决定要让我的孙辈们的选票也能算数。

sentences.en: People told me they believed Trump won in 2020.
sentences.zh: 人们告诉我，他们相信特朗普在2020年赢了。

sentences.en: The election was stolen.
sentences.zh: 选举被窃取了。

sentences.en: And they were here to fix what they think is a broken system.
sentences.zh: 他们来这里是为了修复他们眼中那个破碎的系统。

sentences.en: I like finding out what was happening.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢弄清楚到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: This is my patriotic chore.
sentences.zh: 这是我的爱国职责。

sentences.en: My purpose is to do my part to honor God and my country by being here to help do what I can in Maricopa County.
sentences.zh: 我的目标是通过在这里尽我所能帮助马里科帕县，来履行我对上帝和国家的敬意。

sentences.en: I think we have a nickname for it.
sentences.zh: 我想我们给它起了个绰号。

sentences.en: It's Action Air Corruption County.
sentences.zh: 叫“行动空气腐败县”。

sentences.en: Oh, Air Corruption County.
sentences.zh: 哦，“空气腐败县”。

sentences.en: Is that what people call it here?
sentences.zh: 这是大家对这里的称呼吗？

sentences.en: Some people do.
sentences.zh: 有些人这么叫。

sentences.en: Because there's a lot of that.
sentences.zh: 因为这里确实有很多那种事。

sentences.en: Volunteer after volunteer told me that in the years since Trump lost the election, they got involved.
sentences.zh: 一位又一位志愿者告诉我，自特朗普输掉选举以来的几年里，他们参与了进来。

sentences.en: Some signed up to work the midterm election.
sentences.zh: 有些人报名参加了中期选举的工作。

sentences.en: A lot of them had volunteered for the mail-in-battle review that Craig helped lead in 2022.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人曾为克雷格在2022年领导的邮寄选票审查工作做过志愿者。

sentences.en: And based on everything they've done and seen, they've only grown more suspicious.
sentences.zh: 基于他们所做和所见的一切，他们只会变得更加怀疑。

sentences.en: I was actually looking at the depth of the dot, because you could tell if a dot had any kind of weight to it.
sentences.zh: 我当时其实是在观察圆点的深度，因为你可以看出圆点是否有任何重量感。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: The ovals being filled in absolutely perfect, like a dot matrix printer.
sentences.zh: 那些椭圆填涂得非常完美，就像点阵打印机打出来的一样。

sentences.en: I wasn't told, hey, this is what we think.
sentences.zh: 没人跟我说，嘿，这是我们的想法。

sentences.en: Just here, do this.
sentences.zh: 只是说，在这儿，做这个。

sentences.en: And all the volunteers that I managed through the course of that project walked away with, oh, my fucking God.
sentences.zh: 而我在那个项目中管理的所有志愿者，离开时都惊呼：天哪，我的老天。

sentences.en: All these ideas that the 2020 election was somehow stolen from Trump aren't new, of course.
sentences.zh: 当然，所有关于2020年大选以某种方式从特朗普手中被窃取的观点都不是什么新鲜事。

sentences.en: They're in the ether of Republican politics all the way up to Trump himself.
sentences.zh: 它们存在于共和党政治的氛围中，一直延伸到特朗普本人。

sentences.en: That's true, even though they've been widely disproven, with scores of lawsuits over alleged election fraud thrown out.
sentences.zh: 这是事实，尽管这些说法已被广泛证伪，且大量关于所谓选举舞弊的诉讼已被驳回。

sentences.en: There's ample evidence that there was no widespread voter fraud in 2020.
sentences.zh: 有充分的证据表明，2020年不存在大规模的选民舞弊。

sentences.en: Government officials, including Republicans, have assured people that election systems are secure.
sentences.zh: 政府官员，包括共和党人，已经向民众保证选举系统是安全的。

sentences.en: But it's important to understand theories of a stolen election are why so many people are here.
sentences.zh: 但重要的是要明白，关于选举被窃取的理论正是这么多人来到这里的原因。

sentences.en: It's their motivation.
sentences.zh: 这是他们的动力。

sentences.en: How many hours have you devoted to volunteering this election season?
sentences.zh: 这个选举季你投入了多少小时做志愿者？

sentences.en: Probably around 35 hours a week.
sentences.zh: 大概每周35小时左右。

sentences.en: I do at least four to six every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天至少做四到六个小时。

sentences.en: Four to six hours every day.
sentences.zh: 每天四到六个小时。

sentences.en: Yes, including Saturday.
sentences.zh: 是的，包括周六。

sentences.en: I give about 50, between 50 and 60 hours a week.
sentences.zh: 我每周投入大约50到60个小时。

sentences.en: Their beliefs in a stolen election aren't just driving them to spend all this time here.
sentences.zh: 他们对选举被窃取的信念不仅促使他们把所有时间花在这里。

sentences.en: They're affecting how they're spending that time here.
sentences.zh: 还影响了他们在这里度过这些时间的方式。

sentences.en: Today I'm late because I was walking neighborhoods, handing out golden tickets, which are...
sentences.zh: 今天我迟到了，因为我一直在走访社区，分发“金票”，也就是……

sentences.en: And just to say, in this office, people are spending time doing the traditional things.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，在这个办公室里，人们也在做传统的事情。

sentences.en: Calling voters, knocking on doors, asking people how they're going to get to the polls.
sentences.zh: 给选民打电话，敲门，询问人们打算如何去投票站。

sentences.en: They are doing those things.
sentences.zh: 他们确实在做这些事。

sentences.en: But a traditional campaign would be laser-focused on that.
sentences.zh: 但传统的竞选活动会专注于这些。

sentences.en: And in this office, the attention is split.
sentences.zh: 而在我们这个办公室，注意力是分散的。

sentences.en: Because Craig and his volunteers are doing a lot of other things.
sentences.zh: 因为克雷格和他的志愿者们还在做很多其他事情。

sentences.en: Back in the corner.
sentences.zh: 在角落里。

sentences.en: While we were walking around, Craig pointed out this one conference room.
sentences.zh: 当我们四处走动时，克雷格指出了这间会议室。

sentences.en: We have some legal representations.
sentences.zh: 我们有一些法律代表。

sentences.en: We kept an office there, and there's war boards wrapped around the walls.
sentences.zh: 我们在那里保留了一个办公室，墙上贴满了“战争板”。

sentences.en: War boards?
sentences.zh: 战争板？

sentences.en: War.
sentences.zh: 战争。

sentences.en: War boards.
sentences.zh: 战争板。

sentences.en: What are war boards?
sentences.zh: 什么是战争板？

sentences.en: The military will say, we're going to go into the war room and prepare for whatever's happening.
sentences.zh: 军方会说，我们要进入作战室，为即将发生的任何事情做准备。

sentences.en: We picked it up as a war room, war board.
sentences.zh: 我们借用了这个说法，叫作战室、战争板。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's just a slang.
sentences.zh: 是的，这只是个俚语。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Craig says in that room, among all the things they're doing, they're spending time on what they call election integrity.
sentences.zh: 克雷格说，在那个房间里，除了他们正在做的所有事情外，他们还花时间处理他们所谓的“选举诚信”问题。

sentences.en: That has included training a huge number of volunteers to observe polling places.
sentences.zh: 这包括培训大量志愿者去观察投票站。

sentences.en: And in fact, Republicans say they have a record number of poll watchers this election.
sentences.zh: 事实上，共和党人表示，这次选举他们拥有创纪录数量的投票观察员。

sentences.en: Hey, how are you doing?
sentences.zh: 嘿，你好吗？

sentences.en: As we keep walking, Craig points to another room.
sentences.zh: 当我们继续走时，克雷格指着另一个房间。

sentences.en: We do have one person that takes care of our servers and our data.
sentences.zh: 我们确实有一个人负责管理我们的服务器和数据。

sentences.en: We're massive data.
sentences.zh: 我们有海量数据。

sentences.en: We collect video.
sentences.zh: 我们收集视频。

sentences.en: We're monitoring stuff.
sentences.zh: 我们在监控各种东西。

sentences.en: We get from the state the voter registration files.
sentences.zh: 我们从州政府那里获取选民登记文件。

sentences.en: And we keep those up to date.
sentences.zh: 我们保持这些文件的更新。

sentences.en: And so we're monitoring those and doing comparison.
sentences.zh: 所以我们一直在监控并进行比对。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇。

sentences.en: So that's a huge hard drive you have.
sentences.zh: 所以你有一个巨大的硬盘。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It's millions of records, not thousands.
sentences.zh: 那是数百万条记录，不是数千条。

sentences.en: Craig says all these computer server systems have been set up to store all types of records and files related to election integrity.
sentences.zh: 克雷格说，所有这些计算机服务器系统都是为了存储与选举诚信相关的各类记录和文件而建立的。

sentences.en: You know, we have a full-blown server room, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们有一个完整的服务器机房，对吧？

sentences.en: So we have big server banks with very large servers in there recording video recording of cameras that are on 24 hours a day, monitoring outside drop boxes all the time.
sentences.zh: 所以我们有大型服务器组，里面有非常大的服务器，记录着24小时不间断的监控摄像头视频，时刻监视着外面的投票箱。

sentences.en: So we need to pull something up from last year.
sentences.zh: 所以我们需要调取去年的东西时。

sentences.en: We've got it.
sentences.zh: 我们都有。

sentences.en: Also among those records are voter registration files.
sentences.zh: 这些记录中还包括选民登记文件。

sentences.en: Remember that mail-in ballot review that Craig and some of these volunteers were a part of
sentences.zh: 还记得克雷格和一些志愿者参与的那次邮寄选票审查吗？

sentences.en: when they went in and compared signatures from ballots to voter registration files to see if the signatures were a match.
sentences.zh: 当时他们进去比对选票上的签名和选民登记文件，看看签名是否匹配。

sentences.en: The whole reason they came to believe that 10% of the mail-in ballots in 2020 should not have been counted.
sentences.zh: 他们之所以认为2020年10%的邮寄选票不应该被计入，全是因为这个。

sentences.en: Well, this year, we have every intention to be in those files again, asking volunteers, just regular citizens, to scrutinize voter signatures, and maybe even challenge them.
sentences.zh: 嗯，今年，我们完全打算再次进入这些文件，要求志愿者，也就是普通公民，去审查选民签名，甚至可能提出质疑。

sentences.en: You can imagine all the ways that citizens looking for suspicious activity or raising questions about signatures could affect this election.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象，公民寻找可疑活动或对签名提出质疑，可能会以各种方式影响这次选举。

sentences.en: It could delay things.
sentences.zh: 这可能会拖延进度。

sentences.en: Perfectly valid votes could get challenged.
sentences.zh: 完全有效的选票可能会受到质疑。

sentences.en: It could be chaotic.
sentences.zh: 这可能会造成混乱。

sentences.en: Or it could add up to a big waste of their time.
sentences.zh: 或者这可能只是浪费他们的大量时间。

sentences.en: There are lots of possibilities.
sentences.zh: 有很多种可能性。

sentences.en: No matter how it goes, all this focus on what they consider election integrity takes resources away from the traditional work of a campaign office.
sentences.zh: 无论结果如何，所有这些对他们所谓的“选举诚信”的关注，都会占用竞选办公室传统工作的资源。

sentences.en: Resources spent on efforts like this are resources not spent on getting out the vote.
sentences.zh: 投入到这类工作上的资源，就无法用于动员选民投票。

sentences.en: You can also imagine that all the skepticism about elections could hurt voter outreach.
sentences.zh: 你也可以想象，所有这些对选举的怀疑可能会损害选民的参与度。

sentences.en: Do you worry by talking more about election integrity that it might actually create more distrust?
sentences.zh: 你是否担心通过更多地谈论选举诚信，实际上可能会造成更多的不信任？

sentences.en: Well, that's an Achilles heel.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那是阿喀琉斯之踵。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's not without merit.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这并非毫无根据。

sentences.en: A lot of voters right now that didn't vote in 22 didn't vote because they did not trust the election system to count their vote.
sentences.zh: 现在很多在22年没投票的选民，是因为他们不相信选举系统会公正计票。

sentences.en: They said, well, why should I vote?
sentences.zh: 他们说，好吧，我为什么要投票？

sentences.en: If there's going to be a cheat, why should I vote?
sentences.zh: 如果会有舞弊，我为什么要投票？

sentences.en: And it's difficult sometimes to really convince people that it's absolutely critical to vote.
sentences.zh: 有时确实很难真正说服人们投票是绝对关键的。

sentences.en: It's difficult because they're encouraging people to vote at the exact same time they're telling people their vote might not count.
sentences.zh: 这很困难，因为他们在鼓励人们投票的同时，也在告诉人们他们的选票可能不会被计入。

sentences.en: So given these two things, I asked Craig what he wants Republican voters to do.
sentences.zh: 所以考虑到这两点，我问克雷格他希望共和党选民怎么做。

sentences.en: And his advice is a little confusing.
sentences.zh: 他的建议有点令人困惑。

sentences.en: Our message is, if you get a mail-in ballot, the number one priority is, is vote it.
sentences.zh: 我们的信息是，如果你收到了邮寄选票，首要任务是，投掉它。

sentences.en: What we'd like to see you do is go in on election day, turn in your, spoil your mail-in ballot and vote in person.
sentences.zh: 我们希望看到你做的是，在选举日当天去投票站，交回你的邮寄选票，作废它，然后亲自投票。

sentences.en: That's the beSt.
sentences.zh: 那是最好的。

sentences.en: And you can run through the tabulator and you're done.
sentences.zh: 你可以通过计票机，然后就完成了。

sentences.en: But if you don't do that, then at least turn it in.
sentences.zh: 但如果你不这样做，那么至少把它交上去。

sentences.en: And we don't want you to turn it in late.
sentences.zh: 我们不希望你迟交。

sentences.en: Just to be clear, Craig has been telling people to vote in person.
sentences.zh: 明确一下，克雷格一直告诉人们要亲自投票。

sentences.en: And if they can't do that, he wants them to take their mail-in ballot to the polls and use it as a guide to vote in person.
sentences.zh: 如果他们做不到，他希望他们带着邮寄选票去投票站，并将其作为亲自投票的参考。

sentences.en: And if they can't do that, only as a last resort, mail it in.
sentences.zh: 如果他们连这都做不到，那只能作为最后手段，邮寄回去。

sentences.en: Do you worry that that might actually confuse people?
sentences.zh: 你是否担心这实际上可能会让人们感到困惑？

sentences.en: Or like, a voter might say, that's a lot of hoops to jump through.
sentences.zh: 或者说，选民可能会说，这太麻烦了。

sentences.en: I don't want to think about it.
sentences.zh: 我不想考虑这些了。

sentences.en: I'm just not going to vote.
sentences.zh: 我干脆不投票了。

sentences.en: Well, yeah, the one thing we would leave them with is vote.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的，我们要留给他们的唯一一件事就是：去投票。

sentences.en: No matter what you do, vote.
sentences.zh: 无论你做什么，去投票。

sentences.en: That's the number one priority is vote.
sentences.zh: 首要任务就是投票。

sentences.en: You have to exercise your right to vote.
sentences.zh: 你必须行使你的投票权。

sentences.en: Before I left the Maricopa County Republican offices,
sentences.zh: 在我离开马里科帕县共和党办公室之前，

sentences.en: I asked Craig if all of this was the right approach or whether he wishes he didn't have to do any of this, that he could just focus on getting votes out and winning.
sentences.zh: 我问克雷格，这一切是否是正确的方法，或者他是否希望不必做这些，而能专注于动员投票并赢得胜利。

sentences.en: Craig sees it differently because he says he genuinely believes the election was stolen last time.
sentences.zh: 克雷格的看法不同，因为他说他真心相信上次选举是被窃取的。

sentences.en: So to him, this is part of winning.
sentences.zh: 所以对他来说，这是获胜的一部分。

sentences.en: They're doing exactly what they should be doing.
sentences.zh: 他们正在做他们应该做的事情。

sentences.en: And the effort, he says, is huge.
sentences.zh: 而且他说，这项工作规模巨大。

sentences.en: After the break, my colleague Jonathan Swan makes sense of what we saw in Maricopa County and explains how it fits into Trump's strategy to win the election.
sentences.zh: 休息之后，我的同事乔纳森·斯旺将解读我们在马里科帕县所见的一切，并解释它如何融入特朗普赢得选举的战略中。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 我是温·洛。

sentences.zh: 我编写《Connections》游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一。

sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.zh: 我还喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基。

sentences.zh: 我每天负责制作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的人们制作的。

sentences.zh: 前往 nytimes.com/games 立即开始游戏。

sentences.en: Jonathan, hi.
sentences.zh: 乔纳森，你好。

sentences.en: Great to have you here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你能来。

sentences.en: Hi, Rachel.
sentences.zh: 你好，瑞秋。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: So, Jonathan, you cover Donald Trump's presidential campaign.
sentences.zh: 乔纳森，你负责报道唐纳德·特朗普的总统竞选活动。

sentences.en: And my colleague, who is a daily producer, Jess Chung, she went out to Trump's field office in Maricopa County in Arizona recently.
sentences.zh: 我的同事，也是一位日常制片人杰斯·钟，她最近去了特朗普在亚利桑那州马里科帕县的竞选办公室。

sentences.en: And what she found was this operation that, at least on the surface, seemed a little bit scrambled.
sentences.zh: 她发现那里的运作至少表面上看起来有点混乱。

sentences.en: There was, of course, the regular campaigning stuff.

sentences.zh: 我现在就告诉你……

sentences.en: I will tell you right now...
sentences.zh: 这就是唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: Immigration is the number one issue.
sentences.zh: 移民问题是头等大事。

sentences.en: That beats it all out to me.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这压倒了一切。

sentences.en: It's not even close.
sentences.zh: 甚至没法比。

sentences.en: The United States is now...
sentences.zh: 美国现在……

sentences.en: That beats it out.
sentences.zh: 这确实更重要。

sentences.en: Trump has been having with his advisors for weeks.
sentences.zh: 特朗普几周来一直与他的顾问们讨论这个问题。

sentences.en: So it's not like he's not talking about the economy.
sentences.zh: 所以并不是说他没在谈论经济。

sentences.en: He's doing a ton of economy-themed events at his advisor's beheSt.
sentences.zh: 在顾问的敦促下，他举办了大量以经济为主题的活动。

sentences.en: And he's doing economy-focused interviews, you know.
sentences.zh: 而且你也知道，他还在进行以经济为重点的采访。

sentences.en: So it's not that he's not talking about it.
sentences.zh: 所以并不是说他没在谈论这个话题。

sentences.en: And certainly their paid advertising has been talking a lot about it.
sentences.zh: 当然，他们的付费广告也一直在大量讨论这个问题。

sentences.en: But there has been a disagreement between campaign's data and Trump's gut.
sentences.zh: 但竞选团队的数据与特朗普的直觉之间存在分歧。

sentences.en: And Trump is going with his gut in terms of his emphasis of immigration.
sentences.zh: 而特朗普在强调移民问题上选择了相信自己的直觉。

sentences.en: You know, it really feels like people are often overestimating Trump or underestimating Trump.
sentences.zh: 你知道，人们往往会高估或低估特朗普，感觉确实如此。

sentences.en: Like, either they think that he's some kind of marketing genius who knows exactly how to connect with people when he follows his gut.
sentences.zh: 比如，要么人们认为他是个营销天才，当他跟随直觉时，他非常清楚如何与民众建立联系。

sentences.en: Or they think he's like a delusional narcissist who only acts out of impulse or self-intereSt.
sentences.zh: 要么人们认为他是个妄想的自恋者，行事全凭冲动或私利。

sentences.en: And when you look at this campaign, I feel like it might be hard to tell whether you think that some of these tactics are genius or insane or both.
sentences.zh: 当你审视这场竞选时，我觉得很难判断你认为这些策略是天才之举、疯狂之举，还是两者兼有。

sentences.en: What do you make of it when you look at it?
sentences.zh: 当你观察这一切时，你怎么看？

sentences.en: Well, it's pretty hard to make any declarations about this until we see the election results.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在看到选举结果之前，很难对此做出任何定论。

sentences.en: And even after then, there's going to be...
sentences.zh: 即便在那之后，也还会有……

sentences.en: This always happens.
sentences.zh: 这种情况总是发生。

sentences.en: The winning campaign, everything they did was genius.
sentences.zh: 获胜的竞选团队，他们所做的一切都被视为天才之举。

sentences.en: And then the losing campaign are just a bunch of idiots.
sentences.zh: 而失败的竞选团队则被视为一群白痴。

sentences.en: And the truth is that neither is necessarily true.
sentences.zh: 但事实是，这两者未必都是真的。

sentences.en: But I think the campaign and Trump have made some pretty significant bets in this election.
sentences.zh: 不过我认为，竞选团队和特朗普在这场选举中下了一些相当大的赌注。

sentences.en: And those bets will either prove to be really smart or fatally flawed.
sentences.zh: 这些赌注要么被证明非常明智，要么会成为致命的败笔。

sentences.en: What I will say is that the bets they've made, in some cases, are bets of necessity.
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，在某些情况下，他们所下的赌注是出于无奈。

sentences.en: I'll just give you one example.
sentences.zh: 我给你举个例子。

sentences.en: They have made a huge bet that they will turn out people who don't usually vote.
sentences.zh: 他们押下重注，认为能动员那些通常不投票的人出来投票。

sentences.en: And that will either be a spectacular success or these people who like Trump or lean towards Trump may not bother to vote or they may not have the ground operation that is effective enough to get those people to the polls.
sentences.zh: 这要么会取得巨大的成功，要么那些喜欢特朗普或倾向于特朗普的人可能根本懒得去投票，又或者他们的地面行动不够有效，无法将这些人带到投票站。

sentences.en: And that's a bet.
sentences.zh: 这就是一场赌博。

sentences.en: But I'm not sure what else they could do.
sentences.zh: 但我不知道他们还能做什么。

sentences.en: It's not like you'd send Donald Trump around to go to a bunch of Whole Foods in, you know, North Arlington and talk to all the mums there and say, hey, you know,
sentences.zh: 你总不能让唐纳德·特朗普去阿灵顿北部的全食超市，跟那里的妈妈们聊天，然后说，嘿，你知道吗，

sentences.en: I'm going to be your protector.
sentences.zh: 我会成为你们的保护者。

sentences.en: You know, as he's been saying, I'd be the protector of women.
sentences.zh: 你知道，正如他一直所说的那样，我会成为女性的保护者。

sentences.en: You know, I don't know how much room Donald Trump has to move with suburban women, for example.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我不知道唐纳德·特朗普在郊区女性选民中还有多少争取空间，举个例子。

sentences.en: So, yes, it's a bet, it's a gamble, but they're working with what they've got.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这是一场赌博，但他们是在利用现有资源尽力而为。

sentences.en: The candidate is the candidate they've got.
sentences.zh: 候选人就是他们现有的这位。

sentences.en: It's not like the views about Donald Trump are hugely malleable at this point.
sentences.zh: 目前看来，人们对唐纳德·特朗普的看法并不是那么容易改变的。

sentences.en: They're just going where, they're fishing where the fish are.
sentences.zh: 他们只是在有鱼的地方钓鱼。

sentences.en: And we'll see.
sentences.zh: 我们拭目以待。

sentences.en: Maybe they didn't have the infrastructure in place to pull this off.
sentences.zh: 也许他们没有足够的基础设施来完成这件事。

sentences.en: But I think based on the electorate as it is, it's pretty hard to argue with their strategy, I would say.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，基于目前的选民情况，我认为很难反驳他们的策略。

sentences.en: You know, this whole conversation and looking at the difference between the Harris campaign and the Trump campaign, you've got this one traditional, well-funded,
sentences.zh: 你知道，整个这场对话，审视哈里斯竞选团队和特朗普竞选团队之间的差异，你拥有一个传统的、资金充足的、

sentences.en: well-oiled machine and this other one that looks very non-traditional.
sentences.zh: 运转良好的机器，而另一个看起来非常非传统。

sentences.en: And it's such an incredibly close race.
sentences.zh: 而且选情极其胶着。

sentences.en: And as you said, like, we're not going to really know much about what worked and what didn't work until after the election.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，在选举结束之前，我们真的不会知道什么奏效了，什么没奏效。

sentences.en: So it just keeps reminding me of that great quote from the screenwriter William Goldman, nobody knows anything.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起了编剧威廉·戈德曼的那句名言：没人知道任何事。

sentences.en: And he's talking about the movie business, and he's saying nobody really knows what's going to work, how to pick a hit.
sentences.zh: 他指的是电影业，他说没人真正知道什么会成功，如何挑选热门作品。

sentences.en: But I keep thinking about that quote on this campaign.
sentences.zh: 但我一直在竞选中想起这句话。

sentences.en: Like, does anybody actually know what will win this election?
sentences.zh: 比如，真的有人知道什么能赢得这场选举吗？

sentences.en: I mean, the short answer is no.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，简短的回答是不知道。

sentences.en: I mean, you talk to anyone on either side, and they will tell you the data indicate this is as close a presidential election as they've ever seen, a true jump ball election.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你和任何一方的人交谈，他们都会告诉你，数据显示这是他们见过的最胶着的总统选举，一场真正的五五开选举。

sentences.en: And it's going to be decided if the data is correct, maybe we'll have another polling error like we have the last two times Trump's been on the ballot.
sentences.zh: 如果数据准确，结果将由它决定，也许我们会像特朗普参选的过去两次那样，再次出现民调误差。

sentences.en: But if the data are correct, you know, you're going to have, again, these states decided by potentially tens of thousands of votes.
sentences.zh: 但如果数据是正确的，你知道，这些州的胜负可能再次由数万张选票决定。

sentences.en: And when that's the case, any factor, you could pick out any factor as decisive.
sentences.zh: 当情况如此时，任何因素，你都可以挑出任何因素作为决定性因素。

sentences.en: When you're talking about these kind of tiny wafer-thin margins, you know, anything could end up being the decisive factor.
sentences.zh: 当你谈论这种极其微小的差距时，你知道，任何事情最终都可能成为决定性因素。

sentences.en: Jonathan, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 乔纳森，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: And giving a speech aimed at mobilizing supporters in this final stretch.
sentences.zh: 并发表旨在动员支持者在最后冲刺阶段行动起来的演讲。

sentences.en: So let's spend these next nine days knowing we did everything we could.
sentences.zh: 所以让我们在接下来的九天里，确保我们已经尽了全力。

sentences.en: For his part, Donald Trump also traveled to Michigan and Pennsylvania for campaign events over the weekend, but spent Sunday night in his hometown, New York City,
sentences.zh: 就唐纳德·特朗普而言，他周末也前往密歇根州和宾夕法尼亚州参加竞选活动，但周日晚上是在他的家乡纽约市度过的，

sentences.en: where he hosted a rally at Madison Square Garden.
sentences.zh: 他在那里麦迪逊广场花园举办了一场集会。

sentences.en: And I just want to say a very big hello to a special place, New York, and to an incredible arena, Madison Square Garden.
sentences.zh: 我只想对一个特别的地方——纽约，以及一个不可思议的场馆——麦迪逊广场花园，说一声大大的问候。

sentences.en: Incredible.
sentences.zh: 不可思议。

sentences.en: What was meant as a closing argument for Trump that featured TV personalities, entertainers, and other notable voices from the right devolved into a carnival of grievances,
sentences.zh: 这场本意是特朗普的总结陈词，邀请了电视名人、艺人以及其他来自右翼的知名人士，结果却演变成了一场充斥着不满、

sentences.en: misogyny, and racism.
sentences.zh: 厌女症和种族主义的狂欢。

sentences.en: Several of the speakers made crude and inflammatory remarks about Puerto Ricans, Palestinians, Jews, and even a black man in the audience.
sentences.zh: 几位演讲者对波多黎各人、巴勒斯坦人、犹太人，甚至观众席上的一名黑人发表了粗鲁且煽动性的言论。

sentences.en: Trump himself referenced remarks he's made recently about how the greatest threat America faces is, quote, the enemy from within.
sentences.zh: 特朗普本人提到了他最近发表的言论，称美国面临的最大威胁是，引用他的话，内部的敌人。

sentences.en: The rally was a capstone for an increasingly aggrieved campaign for Donald Trump, whose rhetoric has grown darker and more menacing.
sentences.zh: 这场集会是唐纳德·特朗普日益充满怨气的竞选活动的巅峰之作，他的言辞变得越来越阴暗和具有威胁性。

sentences.en: And Israel launched a retaliatory strike on Iran early Saturday, about three weeks after Iran fired waves of ballistic missiles at Israel.
sentences.zh: 以色列在周六早些时候对伊朗发动了报复性打击，大约在伊朗向以色列发射多波弹道导弹三周后。

sentences.en: The latest strikes marked a new escalation between the two arch rivals, although they appeared designed to stop short of all-out war.
sentences.zh: 最新的袭击标志着这两个宿敌之间的新一轮升级，尽管它们看起来旨在避免全面战争。

sentences.en: Israel avoided striking nuclear sites that the Biden administration had warned against hitting, and instead targeted military facilities.
sentences.zh: 以色列避免了打击拜登政府警告过的核设施，转而针对军事设施。

sentences.en: Saturday also marked the first time that Israel has acknowledged conducting a military operation inside Iran.
sentences.zh: 周六也标志着以色列首次承认在伊朗境内开展军事行动。
